@@leveling2@@{{{leveling2}}}@@leveling3@@{{{leveling3}}}@@leveling4@@{{{leveling4}}}@@leveling5@@{{{leveling5}}}@@leveling6@@{{{leveling6}}}@@range@@{{{range}}}@@radius@@{{{radius}}}@@effectradius@@{{{effect radius}}}@@width@@{{{width}}}@@speed@@{{{speed}}}@@casttime@@none@@cost@@45@@cooldown@@12 / 11 / 10 / 9 / 8@@targeting@@Auto@@damagetype@@Physical@@spellshield@@@@projectile@@Special@@notes@@ * The landing location is determined by '''Draven's''' [[movement speed]] and direction at the time ''Spinning Axe'' hits the target. If '''Draven''' is actually moving, it will bounce directly into his path. Otherwise, it will bounce back towards his current location, either landing directly onto him or to his sides. * ''Spinning Axe'' will place a visual cue on the ground where it will land. This visual cue is visible to both teams, although '''Draven''' himself will see a more prominent marker. * Axes take roughly 1.35-1.40s to go from target to landing point. This is not affected by attack speed, movement speed or level. * Recasting ''Spinning Axe'' will refresh the [[File:Promote.png|20px|link=Buff|An icon representing the keyword Buff]] [[:Buff|buff]] and add another axe if possible. ** There is no limit to how many axes can be juggled at once, just the limit of 2 of them at a time in '''Draven's''' hands. * '''Draven''' used to be able to catch (steal) an enemy '''Draven''''s axes. This event also prompted a few unique voice lines. * ''Spinning Axes'' may optically bypass [[File:Yasuo Wind Wall.png|20xpx|border|link=Yasuo#Wind Wall|An icon for Yasuo's ability Wind Wall]] [[Yasuo#Wind Wall|Wind Wall]] and [[File:Samira Blade Whirl.png|20xpx|border|link=Samira#Blade Whirl|An icon for Samira's ability Blade Whirl]] [[Samira#Blade Whirl|Blade Whirl]] but they will be destroyed upon collision. [[File:Braum Unbreakable.png|20xpx|border|link=Braum#Unbreakable|An icon for Braum's ability Unbreakable]] [[Braum#Unbreakable|Unbreakable]] will not prevent the axe from bouncing off when [[File:Braum OriginalSquare.png|20xpx|border|link=Braum|An icon representing Braum]] [[Braum]] is the target. * [[File:Braum Unbreakable.png|20xpx|border|link=Braum#Unbreakable|An icon for Braum's ability Unbreakable]] [[Braum#Unbreakable|Unbreakable]] will not prevent the axe from bouncing off when [[File:Braum OriginalSquare.png|20xpx|border|link=Braum|An icon representing Braum]] [[Braum]] is not the target. * The axe will still bounce against parrying effects. * [[File:Runaan's Hurricane item.png|20xpx|border|link=Runaan's Hurricane|An icon for the item Runaan's Hurricane]] [[Runaan's Hurricane|Runaan's Hurricane's]] [[Named item effect#Wind's Fury|Wind's Fury]] does not interact with the effects of the axes. * If a ''Spinning Axe'' is readied during a basic attack wind-up, the effects will be applied to the fired attack. * ''Spinning Axe'' attacks deal their total increased damage in a single instance of [[File:Basic Attack.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Basic damage]] [[:Damage|basic damage]]. * ''Spinning Axe'' may fail to properly bounce back if it hits [[File:Zaahen OriginalSquare.png|20xpx|border|link=Zaahen|An icon representing Zaahen]] [[Zaahen]] during or shortly after [[File:Zaahen Cultivation of War.png|20xpx|border|link=Zaahen#Cultivation of War|An icon for Zaahen's ability Cultivation of War]] [[Zaahen#Cultivation of War|Cultivation of War's]] revive.(bug) * The empowered attack will not trigger against [[File:Structure icon.png|20px|link=Category:Structure|An icon representing the keyword Structure]] [[:Category:Structure|structures]]. ** The duration will refresh on-attack against them. * ''Spinning Axe'' has an indicator that appears on the ground for Draven to stand on. Some skins have a unique indicator.
